### 8.2 Event kinds

Every event has a `kind`. A chat message is `message` with `type: chat`; see [the events section](https://github.com/oliver-zehentleitner/maity/blob/main/docs/api.md#8-events).

- `message` — a chat, a handover or a blocker
- `task_updated` — a card changed

Ask @agent-a about tsk-0123456789ab before changing it.
